_about: Game-wide numbers the mod changes. One row per system; build_regulation.py and the DLL read these.

rows.what: How much bigger than a Tarnished the frame stands (model scale set by the DLL; hit capsule height set by SpEffect 99900100) (capsule rate back to 1.0: a 2x-tall hit capsule snagged on stairs and rocks)
Follow camera pulled back and raised to suit the bigger frame: LockCamParam rows 0 (free camera) and 1 (lock-on camera)
New characters are warped out of the Chapel of Anticipation to the Limgrave arrival point (patched event script written from the player's own copy)
Game versions the mod's code add-on supports (the Elden Ring library it uses only knows these)

rows.note: AC6 weapon numbers come from sheets/weapon_stats.json (tools/ac6_weapons.py). damage_scale converts AC6 damage points into Elden Ring damage (AC6 enemies have ~10x the HP); gun projectiles are spawned by the DLL from Bullet rows 999100x0 (+1 charged) built by tools/build_regulation.py. aim_height_m/muzzle_forward_m place the muzzle relative to the frame. blade_lunge = AC6 BladeHoming speed 340 km/h x 0.3 for blade_lunge_s.
